data.one_liner: Animated dithered animal widgets and custom image renderers for Flutter with 50 presets.
data.what_it_does: Renders animated chibi animals and custom images on the Flutter Canvas using an ordered 8x8 Bayer dithering matrix. It supports interactive poke ripple physics, facial expressions, signature moves, and multiple dot shapes.
use_when: You want retro dithered stipple or halftone art styles in your Flutter app.
You need cute animated animal companions, avatars, or logos with interactive touch physics.
avoid_when: You require realistic vector graphics or high-definition photo rendering without retro rasterization.
You need complex game physics engines.
strengths: Includes 50 handcrafted chibi animal presets with signature animations.
Interactive poke shockwaves and haptic feedback.
Supports custom image dithering via any Flutter ImageProvider.
weaknesses: Limited to dithered pixel/halftone aesthetic rendering.
Not suited for general-purpose animation of arbitrary non-dithered UI components.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Lottie if you prefer vector-based vector animations instead of dithered pixel matrices.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Rive if you need interactive state-machine driven vector animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_animate for general-purpose widget motion and choreography rather than specialized dithered animal graphics.
